title: Source-authorized U_n and common-space evidence intake for PAH-OMC-020
purpose: Freeze the one missing evidence packet needed before testing the varying-space N2a--N2d obligations. This is a researcher-owned intake contract, not a U_n definition, a common-space theorem, or a temporal convergence result.

fixed_scope.functional_and_rates: Use exactly the PAH-001 functional and original directed PH/LK/AP/TR rates through the pinned OMC-018 source chain. No refit, counterterm, conditional averaging, rate change or new carrier.
fixed_scope.finite_spaces: Use the original labelled finite G_n spaces, their PAH-001 stationary laws and the declared j-before-n regulator order. No direct sum of phases or charge sectors is admitted as a rescue.
fixed_scope.limit_hilbert_space: Use the single R-510 anchored limit Hilbert space and the R-512 minimal closed form exactly at their pinned scope. No alternate extension is silently substituted.
fixed_scope.comparison_maps: The packet must supply U_n (or an explicitly equivalent map) from every finite L2(nu_n) space into the fixed target H. The existing coordinate pullback is only a local-cylinder candidate and is not pre-admitted as a full-space map.
fixed_scope.time: Retain the original external unaccelerated Markov time. It is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.

acceptance_conditions.owner_authority: A versioned owner declaration identifies the exact packet, signer or authority, source provenance, non-post-hoc parameter policy and SHA-256 hash before any estimate is evaluated.
acceptance_conditions.common_hilbert_realization: For every n, specify measurable spaces, measures, the target H, domains and an explicit U_n with the inner product and norm convention. State whether U_n is linear, bounded, isometric or only locally defined; no property may be inferred from notation.
acceptance_conditions.local_cylinder_recovery: For each finite-support cylinder f, provide an explicit stabilization N(f) and the exact norm/inner-product convergence required by the PAH-OMC-020 N1 contract.
acceptance_conditions.n2b_liminf: For every sequence u_n whose images converge weakly in the declared topology and whose E_n energies are bounded, prove the PAH-specific inequality E_infty(u,u) <= liminf_n E_n(u_n,u_n) with all quantifiers and constants.
acceptance_conditions.recovery_limsup: For every u in the declared target form domain, provide a compatible u_n sequence and prove the required limsup/recovery estimate without changing the finite forms.
acceptance_conditions.n2c_n4_boundary_escape: For every local cylinder and compact time interval, prove that roots outside a fixed prefix contribute vanishingly under the original unbounded rates, including the boundary labels and the stated regulator order.
acceptance_conditions.n2d_minimal_identification: Prove that the selected closed limit form/operator is the R-512 minimal closure, rather than a maximal jump form or an unspecified boundary extension.
acceptance_conditions.verification: Supply primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean checks for the model-specific map, form estimates, boundary estimate and minimal identification. Each run must record exact commands, source hashes, assumptions, failures and non-claims.

required_owner_payload: packet_id, version, owner authority and SHA-256
measurable/probability realization of every finite space and the common H
explicit U_n (or equivalent) with domain, linearity and norm/inner-product control
N1 local-cylinder stabilization and recovery quantifiers
N2b arbitrary-sequence weak-liminf theorem with topology and bounded-energy quantifiers
compatible limsup/recovery sequence for every target-form vector
N2c/N4 compact-time boundary-escape estimate for the unchanged generator
N2d identification with the R-512 minimal closed form
primary, independent, hostile and Lean reproducibility manifests
forbidden_repairs: Changing PAH-001 functional, transition rates, mobility, state, carrier, regulator or limit order
Conditional Gibbs averaging, phasewise or cross-Q direct-sum selection, fitted density weights or post-hoc parameter tuning
Treating the coordinate local pullback as a bounded completed-space map without a source estimate
Importing a generic Mosco, strong-resolvent or semigroup theorem without discharging its PAH-specific hypotheses
Replacing the R-512 minimal closure by a maximal or boundary-selected extension
Interpreting external Markov time as physical time or promoting the packet to Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE evidence

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Admit only when every required payload item is hash-pinned and all five verification roles agree on the same unchanged PAH model and quantifiers.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Use only for an exact counterexample inside the unchanged PAH definitions; distinguish a coordinate-map obstruction from a universal impossibility claim.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Use when any owner field, common-space estimate, boundary estimate, minimal-identification proof or independent verification is absent or ambiguous. The current contract is in this state.

current_finding: The pinned repository evidence contains no source-authorized full-space U_n/common-Hilbert packet satisfying the required map, liminf, recovery, boundary and minimal-identification fields. This is an evidence hold, not a universal nonexistence theorem.
single_next_question: Can one source-authorized owner provide the complete nine-field U_n/common-space packet, with unchanged PAH-001 definitions and independent/hostile/Lean verification, so that N2b, N2c/N4 and N2d can be tested once rather than inferred?
revisit_condition: Reopen the temporal proof only after a packet with every required field is supplied and its parent hashes remain unchanged; otherwise retain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE and do not repeat finite tables.
non_claims: This contract does not define U_n or prove common-space closability, Mosco convergence, boundary escape, minimal-form selection or PAH-OMC-020 semigroup convergence.
No universal impossibility claim is made from repository absence; external or future owner input is not assessed.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang--Mills or TOE conclusion follows.
External Markov time remains a stochastic parameter and is not physical time.
